name: chunk_fact_support
description: Judge which atomic facts are supported by a single retrieved passage.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements are fully supported by the passage?

instructions.title: Identify Supported Facts
instructions.summary: Read a retrieved passage and select all atomic statements that it supports.
instructions.background: We are evaluating how well individual passages cover specific factual claims. Your task is to determine if the text in the passage provides enough evidence to confirm each statement.
definitions: The passage explicitly states or logically implies the fact without contradiction.
All parts of the statement (who, what, when) are present in the passage.
howto: Check each atomic statement against the passage.
Select all statements that are fully supported.
If no statements are supported, select 'None of the above'.
instructions.tip: Do not use outside knowledge; rely only on the provided passage.
